evidence.observation: Ramp reaches 749.3 °C versus 749.6 °C setpoint with 81.8% heater power and 99.5 sccm Ar versus 100 sccm.
Growth transition shows a transient temperature overshoot to 760.4 °C as heater power falls to 38.7%.
Temperature has settled to 750.2 °C against 750 °C setpoint; heater power is 45.2%, Ar is 99.6 sccm against 100 sccm, and status is running.
Pressure and exhaust oxygen sensors are not installed; null readings are not evidence of a fault.
